name: mint-bikini-luxury-vacation
image_purpose: show a natural luxury-resort vacation moment

prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic luxury resort poolside vacation image with natural lifestyle framing.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with blonde hair and natural makeup, seated comfortably on a wicker lounge chair, wearing a mint-green triangle bikini and simple gold jewelry. Preserve the calm smile and hand near the cheek as a relaxed holiday pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait with wicker lounge chair and beige cushion, thatched straw umbrella, turquoise pool, deck loungers, beige stucco resort buildings with arched balconies, and palms. Keep the face and upper body naturally prominent without sexualized framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight with warm golden-hour influence, soft sunlight filtered through straw, gentle shadows, vibrant balanced blues, greens, and warm highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic DSLR look, 50mm lens, shallow natural depth of field, sharp facial detail, realistic skin and wicker texture, balanced color grading.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic relaxed luxury-resort poolside vacation portrait of one generic approved adult blonde woman seated on a beige-cushioned wicker lounge chair under a thatched straw umbrella, mint-green triangle bikini, simple gold jewelry, calm natural smile with one hand near her cheek, turquoise pool, beige stucco resort with arched balconies and palms, warm soft daylight, realistic materials, 50mm DSLR look.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, plastic skin, CGI, illustration, text, watermark, logo artifacts

assets.name: resort-poolside-reference
assets.usage: Match seated pose, mint outfit, wicker chair, resort pool, umbrella, and warm daylight. Replaceable with another approved resort-lifestyle image.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve generic adult identity cues, relaxed outfit category, pose, resort environment, and natural vacation mood. Optional replacement references may change hair, outfit color, chair, or resort architecture while retaining the same story. Products, environment details, and logos remain absent unless approved; no typography.
